answer: Copying the same citations across 291 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 291 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the lotus check immediately, the haven audit keeps the resolved set and the thread replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
